SELECT
COALESCE(sum( a.`total` ),0) `total`, COALESCE(sum( a.`flow` ),0) `flow`, COALESCE(sum( a.`duration` ),0) `duration`
FROM `water_data_month` a where 1=1
and a.`data_time` between #{param.startTime} and #{param.endTime}
and a.`department_id` like concat('%',#{param.departmentId},'%')
and a.`shift_master` like concat('%',#{param.shiftMaster},'%')
and a.`code` like concat('%',#{param.code},'%')
and a.`gear_position_code` like concat('%',#{param.gearPositionCode},'%')
and a.`device_code` like concat('%',#{param.deviceCode},'%')
and a.`duration` between #{param.duration.startDuration} and #{param.duration.endDuration}
and a.`flow` between #{param.flowParam.startFlow} and #{param.flowParam.endFlow}

SELECT COUNT(distinct `code`) FROM `water_data_month` WHERE `duration` > 24
and `data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(distinct `code`) FROM `water_data_month` WHERE 1=1
and `data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(distinct `device_code`) FROM `water_data_month` WHERE `duration` > 24
and `data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(distinct `device_code`) FROM `water_data_month` WHERE 1=1
and `data_time` between #{startTime} and #{endTime}
